bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
echo ACTION=CREATOR_MENU_RUNTIME_READ_ONLY
test -d "$root" || { echo ERROR=OWNER_ROOT_MISSING; exit 61; }
docker image inspect create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 --format 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE={{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo CANDIDATE_IMAGE=NOT_FOUND
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
echo POLLER_COUNT="${#ids[@]}"
for cid in "${ids[@]}"; do
 docker inspect "$cid" --format 'CONTAINER={{.Name}} STATE={{.State.Status}} RESTARTS={{.RestartCount}} IMAGE={{.Image}}'
 docker inspect "$cid" --format 'COMPOSE_FILES={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}'
 docker inspect "$cid" --format 'COMPOSE_WORKDIR={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}'
 docker logs --tail 10 "$cid" 2>&1 | sed -E 's/[0-9]{5,}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}/[REDACTED_BOT_TOKEN]/g' | cut -c1-200
done
find "$root" -maxdepth 5 -name 'compose.videobot.poll.yaml' -type f -print
echo ACTION_COMPLETE=READ_ONLY
